ety.text: From Latin -ātiō, an alternative form of -tiō.
Inherited from Proto-Slavic *na desęte. Compare Old Church Slavonic на десѧте (na desęte), Polish -naście. By surface analysis, на (na) + десять (desjatʹ), literally “on ten”.

s.g: Abstract noun suffix; forms part of larger suffixes such as -е́нье (-énʹje), -а́нье (-ánʹje), -тье (-tʹje), and exists on its own especially as a suffix added to compound words.
